name: combobox
title: Combobox
description: A choice from a list of options, one value or several with `multiple`, with groups, separators and notes, and the id and aria props landing on the trigger. One value is radix's listbox on the web and the Select sheet on device; `searchable` and `multiple` draw a Popover over a Command, searchable on every word, with an optional create row and, for several, coloured chips.
